freshProduct.description:
Chrome Parallel Cards 

Ultra-rare Chrome and Opal Chrome pattern Topps NOW® parallels will unlock for cards with large print runs at specific tiers as additional lucky parallels:

50,000+ Print Run: Look for Chrome parallels /99 and /50 + lower parallel structure. 

100,000+ Print Run: Look for Chrome parallels /25, /10, /5 and 1/1 SuperFractor + lower parallel structure. 

250,000+ Print Run: Look for Opal Chrome parallels /50, /25, /10 and /5 + lower parallel structure. 

500,000+ Print Run: Look for 1/1 White OpalFractor Chrome + lower parallel structure.

Capturing all the excitement of World Wrestling Entertainment – Topps NOW brings the biggest moments directly to your collection!

Your Hero. Your Team. Your Moment. ™

Topps NOW celebrates the greatest moments... as they happen! Only available at Topps.com. Print runs for every card are released in the WWE Topps NOW Archive.

The biggest and brightest stars have been selected to the 2026 MLS All-Star Game! Each 11-card set contains the complete ten base card set plus a base parallel, autograph parallel, or Match-used net jewel 1/1 relic or autograph-relic redemption.

The Midsummer Classic will take place at Philadelphia's Citizens Bank Park on July 14 (8 p.m. ET)
